title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and vehicles can be occluded. Prior work therefore conditions video generation on layouts that specify vehicle motion, providing control over surrounding vehicles but requiring their future trajectories as inputs. We introduce BirdDreams, an autoregressive driving world model that jointly generates perspective video and a schematic bird's-eye-view (BEV) video, making scene layout part of the predicted future. The BEV, rendered from scene annotations for training, depicts roads and vehicles as simple shapes at a fixed metric scale, providing a top-down view of their positions and motion with reduced occlusion between vehicles. Perspective video, by contrast, retains scene details that the BEV omits, such as traffic signals and object appearance. Joint attention between two video diffusion transformers, one per stream, lets each stream inform the other during generation. The predicted BEV also provides a geometric interface for ego control: we translate and rotate its latest frame along an input ego trajectory and use the resulting frames as a soft condition that shows how the scene would appear to move if only the ego vehicle moved. At inference, BirdDreams generates both videos from a single camera image without requiring an HD map or vehicle-state inputs. On PhysicalAI-AV and nuScenes, BirdDreams follows input ego trajectories more faithfully than prior driving world models and generates more plausible ego motion without ego-action conditioning. Human evaluation shows that BirdDreams outperforms a perspective-only baseline in generating realistic surrounding-vehicle behavior.

AI.tldr: BirdDreams 让驾驶世界模型同时自回归生成透视视频与示意性 BEV 视频，把场景布局也作为预测未来的一部分；摘要称其在 PhysicalAI-AV 和 nuScenes 上比先前驾驶世界模型更忠实地跟随输入 ego 轨迹，但未给出数值结果。

title: Elastra: A Simulation Framework for Elastic Bodies
summary: When robots interact with elastic surfaces such as mattresses and trampolines, changes in loading cause the surfaces to deform and rebound, altering subsequent contact locations and forces. We present Elastra, a simulation framework for modeling this interaction and supporting the training and evaluation of robot control policies. Elastra represents each surface using elements that move only vertically, with elastic connections and damping to model deformation and recovery. Contact forces drive surface motion, and the updated surface geometry is used to compute subsequent contact forces. We systematically validate our simulations against an independent implementation and a real mattress load curve. We further use Elastra to train the Unitree G1 humanoid to stand up on mattresses and trampolines. Using the pretrained HoST policy and ProtoMotions motion tracker as original controllers, we train residual policies through reinforcement learning to add corrections to their joint targets. Adding these residual policies increases the success rate with HoST from 44.1\% to 72.5\%, and from 55\% to 89\% on the trampoline. With ProtoMotions, the success rate increases from 19.0\% to 45.0\% for initial poses not encountered during training. The code and video are available on this https URL .

AI.tldr: Elastra 用仅竖直运动、带弹性连接与阻尼的单元表示床垫和蹦床等弹性表面，接触力与更新后的表面几何互相迭代；在该仿真中为 G1 人形训练残差策略，站起成功率由 HoST 的 44.1% 升至 72.5%，蹦床 55% 升至 89%。
AI.motivation: 机器人与床垫、蹦床等弹性表面交互时，加载会引起表面形变与回弹，从而改变后续的接触位置和接触力；需要一个能建模这种交互、并支持机器人控制策略训练与评测的仿真框架。
AI.method: 输入是弹性表面与机器人的交互场景：Elastra 把每个表面表示为一组只沿竖直方向运动的单元，单元之间用弹性连接和阻尼来刻画形变与恢复；接触力驱动表面运动，更新后的表面几何再用于计算后续接触力，两个过程交替推进。相对所述基线，方法不重新训练原控制器，而是把预训练的 HoST 策略和 ProtoMotions 运动跟踪器当作原始控制器，用强化学习训练残差策略，在其关节目标上叠加修正量。输出是仿真中的弹性接触动力学，以及可在床垫和蹦床上完成站起动作的策略。
AI.result: 作者报告：加入残差策略后，HoST 的成功率从 44.1% 提升到 72.5%，蹦床上从 55% 提升到 89%；ProtoMotions 在训练中未遇到的初始姿态上从 19.0% 提升到 45.0%（均为摘要给出的绝对百分比数值，即可读作百分点级提升）。仿真验证方面，作者称与一个独立实现和一条真实床垫负载曲线做了系统验证，但摘要未报告任何验证数值指标。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，仅竖直自由度加弹性-阻尼耦合的简化表面模型，配合接触力与几何的交替更新，可以作为一个用于训练和评测控制策略的仿真环境，并且让已有控制器通过残差学习获得收益。证据边界：所有成功率均为作者在其仿真中报告的训练/评测结果，摘要未报告真实机器人部署、sim-to-real 迁移或独立复现结果。

title: Can I join you? Extended Social Force Based Model with Predictive Control and Barrier Functions for Humanoid Group Repositioning Amidst Obstacles
summary: As social and service robots increasingly share interaction spaces in public, they may form groups while coordinating tasks or interacting with humans. Initial group formation alone is insufficient in dynamic settings, because it can be disrupted when a person or another agent joins, leaves, or passes through the group. Although group dynamics and repositioning have been widely studied in swarm robotics and virtual-agent settings, little attention has been given to socially appropriate repositioning behaviors in groups of humanoid robots. Existing social-force-based approaches provide a useful foundation for group behavior, but they have limited obstacle handling, and can produce unsafe behavior as environmental complexity increases. We propose a novel framework that modulates traditional Social Force, guided by Model Predictive Control (MPC) to plan ahead, bounded by Control Barrier Functions (CBF) to increase safety for robot groups repositioning behaviors. This approach aims to produce safer and socially aware group repositioning behaviors under various group formation disturbance. We evaluate the method in simulation through an ablation study and an online user study. The results show that our proposed method can produce smoother and safer repositioning behaviors in complex environments while preserving social appropriateness.

AI.tldr: 针对人形机器人群体在障碍环境中因成员加入、离开或穿行而重定位易被破坏的问题，作者将传统社会力模型与MPC预测控制、CBF安全约束结合，并在仿真消融实验和在线用户研究中声称产生更平滑、更安全且保持社会适当性的群体重定位行为。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注群体初始形成，但动态场景中有人或智能体加入、离开、穿行会破坏群体；同时，社会力方法对障碍处理有限，环境复杂度增加时可能产生不安全行为，而人形机器人群体的社会适当重定位研究仍不足。
AI.method: 输入是群体形成状态及动态扰动（成员加入、离开或穿过）与障碍环境；方法用MPC进行前瞻预测，并以其调制传统社会力模型，再用CBF施加安全约束，输出人形机器人群体的重定位行为。相对基线是传统社会力方法；但摘要未报告具体状态表示、优化目标、约束形式、控制频率与硬件参数。
AI.result: 作者在仿真中通过消融实验和在线用户研究评估，声称所提方法能在复杂环境中产生更平滑、更安全且保持社会适当性的群体重定位行为；摘要未给出任何数值指标、单位或定量基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把MPC与CBF引入社会力框架，为动态障碍下的人形机器人群体社会适当重定位提供了可检验的思路；但现有证据仅为摘要中的定性作者声明，缺少仿真数值和真实机器人结果，不能据此推断定量性能或实际部署效果。
AI.core_method: 用MPC预测调制传统社会力，并以CBF约束安全，生成人形机器人群体重定位行为。

key_results.finding: 作者声称所提方法在复杂环境中产生更平滑、更安全且保持社会适当性的群体重定位行为。

title: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
summary: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native and fragment-level goal attainment, compared with 71.03\% for INTACT, 61.66\% for PRISM, and 58.66\% for LeWM. Component interventions and expert-relative action-structure comparisons support demonstration-informed continuations and reveal task-dependent effects of visual conditioning, history length, and planning horizon.

AI.tldr: 专家演示动作具有时序结构，而通用平滑先验未必反映这种连续性；LG-DKGP 从动作历史预测神经续作并学习时序高斯过程残差，用于冻结世界模型中的规划搜索；作者报告在五个仿真任务上宏成功率为 87.07\%，高于 INTACT 71.03\%、PRISM 61.66\%、LeWM 58.66\%。
AI.motivation: 专家演示中的动作并非独立无关，而具有时序结构：有序-乱序分析在五个环境中确认了这种依赖。摘要提出的问题是，动作提议若更贴近专家连续性，能否改进视觉世界模型规划。
AI.method: 输入包括近期与更长程的已执行动作历史；训练时使用专家未来动作。与通用平滑不同，方法学习演示动作的时序结构：先由神经均值预测一个续作，再用时序 GP 残差校正；训练先拟合神经均值，再联合优化先验与 GP 残差。训练得到的探索尺度围绕校正后均值初始化搜索，冻结的世界模型评估朝向目标的进展；输出是修正后的动作续作/提议，供规划搜索使用。
AI.result: 作者报告，在五个仿真任务（涵盖原生目标与片段级目标达成）上，所提规划器获得 87.07\% 宏成功率，对比 INTACT 71.03\%、PRISM 61.66\%、LeWM 58.66\%。摘要未说明该差异是相对提升还是百分点差异，也未报告统计显著性。有序-乱序分析在五个环境中确认动作时序依赖；组件干预和专家相对动作结构比较支持基于演示的续作，并揭示视觉条件、历史长度与规划视界的任务依赖效应。
AI.conclusion: 对具身智能与世界模型规划而言，这提示可将专家演示的动作时序结构显式编码为规划先验；但证据限于五个仿真任务，摘要未报告真实机器人部署、延迟或统计显著性。
AI.core_method: 从已执行动作历史预测神经续作，再以时序高斯过程残差校正，并用训练得到的探索尺度在世界模型搜索中使用该先验。
